description: Design your personalized gemstone bead bracelet in live 3D through conversation with Lucid Beads. Choose genuine natural gemstones, wrist size, bead finish, pattern, spacers, charm, and optional letter beads, or request recommendations based on your intentions and preferences. Preview your bracelet, then purchase it or customize it further at LucidBeads.com. Each bracelet is handmade to order with free standard shipping on all U.S. orders. International shipping fees apply.
